title: Disabled authentication
responsibility: Provide authentication behavior when sign-in is not configured.

outputs.name: authDisabled
outputs.description: The HubAuth used when sign-in is not configured: actor() always resolves to null, and authorizeRepository() and token() always reject with an AuthFailure whose code is github-disabled. handle() returns a 200 body reporting configured: false for GET /api/auth/status and GET /api/github/status, returns HTTP 503 with the error code auth-disabled for any other request under /api/auth/ or /api/github/, and returns null for any path outside those prefixes.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: authorizeRepository() and token() reject with an AuthFailure whose code is github-disabled, status 503 and message 'Hub auth github-disabled'. actor() and handle() never reject.
